blocks.text: Psalms 1 and 2 are often understood as an untitled gateway to the collection. Psalm 1 contrasts flourishing shaped by the Torah with the way of the wicked; Psalm 2 widens the conflict to rebellious nations confronted by YHWH’s kingship and his anointed king. On this reading, the two psalms together introduce obedience, rebellion, divine rule, and refuge as major concerns at the Psalter’s entrance.
